title: Robotics Lab
description: Build something that moves. Our student team explores sensors, small robots, and the delightful challenge of making hardware and software work together.

title: Campus Garden
description: A greener corner of campus, grown together. We care for shared garden beds, learn about seasonal planting, and turn a little patience into something worth sharing.

title: Open Source Circle
description: Good software starts with a good question. Join a welcoming group of students learning Python, contributing to open source, and helping each other ship small useful projects.

title: Film Society
description: A screen, a story, a conversation. We discover films from around the world and make space for thoughtful discussions about the ideas that stay with us after the credits.

title: Repair Café
description: Give everyday objects a second chapter. Bring your curiosity to our student repair sessions, where we share practical skills and learn to fix things together.

title: Data for Good
description: Make numbers mean something. We turn public datasets into clear stories and small tools that help us understand our campus, our city, and the world around us.
